treatment: Deploy yellow sticky cards to monitor Asian Citrus Psyllid vectors. Apply foliar nutritional sprays (Zinc, Manganese, Iron) to sustain tree vigor.
Apply fixed copper sprays at dormant bud swell and shuck split. Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation.

Vigorous potato vine growth. Hilling soil around stems to encourage tuber expansion and prevent greening.
Canopy clean. Maintain trellis training and prune spent floricanes after fruiting.

Wash hands in 10% non-fat milk solution before handling plants. Remove infected plants; do not compost. Sterilize plant ties and stakes.
